name: p_sshi_zener
rationale: The reference FBR fails on minimum output voltage (S5, S6) because it cannot extract enough power to support heavy loads, especially when the open-circuit voltage is low. A Parallel-SSHI (Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor) topology is implemented to flip the voltage across the piezo capacitance Cp at every extrema, significantly increasing the energy harvested per cycle. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output voltage to ~3.3V, preventing it from exceeding the 3.6V limit in light-load conditions (S3).
